repo_irregularities.title: everymatch/ (session 19d6c262) frozen on 2026-10-19T04:26:08Z due to hardcoded Oct-19 fixture IDs in tests/test_19d6c262.py
repo_irregularities.detail: The scheduled workflow everymatch-19d6c262.yml runs `python3 -m unittest tests.test_19d6c262 -v` before committing. Because tests/test_19d6c262.py hardcodes `len(want) >= 20` and four Oct-19 fixture IDs (1082157, 1081132, 1081863, 1081529) that have since locked and rotated off the lobby, every scheduled run on main (e.g. 39544863841, 39513037654, 39487959240) fails and everymatch/ remains stuck serving 34 matches from 2026-10-19.

repo_irregularities.title: climb/ (session a89b76e9) selects the stale 2026-10-19 board over today's fresh 2026-10-21 board
repo_irregularities.detail: In scripts/a89b76e9/build.py (lines 143-147), `newest_board()` ranks candidate `data/*/board.json` files by `key = (priced, gen)` (number of priced rows first, timestamp only as tie-breaker). Because the frozen 2026-10-19 board (`data/19d6c262/board.json`) had 34 priced matches while today's 2026-10-21 lobby has 19 open matches, `climb/` continuously selects the 2-day-old Oct-19 board (`board_generated_utc: 2026-10-19T04:26:08Z`) even when rebuilt at 2026-10-21 12:09 UTC.

repo_irregularities.title: start/ (371a1ce7), now/ (b3871d16), unresolved/ (7177d07f), and picks-all/ (b5436cf0) scheduled workflows failing on main
repo_irregularities.detail: Scheduled runs for start-371a1ce7 (run 39547202868), now-b3871d16 (run 39548272486), unresolved-7177d07f (run 39564013498), and allpicks-b5436cf0 (run 39547331774) fail their test gates because their tests assert dated Oct 15-18 fixture IDs or TWC Malta Day-5 assumptions. Per COORDINATION.md rules, we do not edit other sessions' files; our `fullpicks/` test suite (`tests/test_51197e5b.py`) tests invariants dynamically against the current board so scheduled refreshes never break as the lobby rotates.

repo_irregularities.title: 1082762 ex-CYBERSHOKE vs BlinkDagger missed by f7279a54 and fe803b80 despite 3 live Bovada / Melbet / Kalshi lines in their own snapshots
repo_irregularities.detail: HotSpawn lists fixture 1082762 as `ex-CYBERSHOKE vs BlinkDagger` (CIS LAN Championship #9, 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z). Both upstream collectors already captured three live two-way markets for this exact match in their `unmatched_quotes`: Bovada (event 32524607, `CYBERSHOKE vs blinkdagger`, 1.125 / 5.750 -> 83.6% / 16.4%), Melbet (event 763402597, `CYBERSHOKE vs BlinkDagger`, 1.12 / 5.59 -> 83.3% / 16.7%), and Kalshi (`KXCS2GAME-26OCT211100BLICS`, `BlinkDagger vs CYBERSHOKE Esports`, $0.19 / $0.81 -> 81.0% / 19.0%). Both upstream matchers failed to join them solely because neither strips the `ex-` prefix (`ex-CYBERSHOKE` vs `CYBERSHOKE`). Our resolver joins all 3 direct quotes (consensus: ex-CYBERSHOKE 82.6% vs BlinkDagger 17.4%).

repo_irregularities.title: 1081600 Donstu vs Banda chuya flipped in fe803b80 / cs2 because Banda Chuya's stale 2-player VRS row (#373) overwrote its active 5-player roster (#165)
repo_irregularities.detail: In Valve's official `standings_global_2026_10_05.md`, `Banda Chuya` appears twice: #165 (801 pts, full 5-man active roster `AdrieN, ezox, maaryy, Showk, tomiko`, latest match 2026-10-04, also confirmed by bo3.gg team 23072 `rank: 165`) and #373 (402 pts, 2-player remnant `ezox, manio`, latest match 2026-09-11). Because `scripts/fe803b80/collect.py` stores `vrs_regions` as a plain `{team_name: row}` dict, the #373 row overwrites #165, causing `fe803b80` (and `cs2/`) to rate Banda Chuya at 402 pts and pick Donstu (61.3%). Against the active #165 (801 pts) 5-player roster, Banda chuya out-rates DONSTU (#197, 732 pts) by +69 VRS points and is the 53.9% favourite. Additionally, bo3.gg match 132216 lists `DONSTU vs los kogutos` in the 2026-10-22T13:45:00Z slot.
